**Package:** EntityFramework 6.2.0  
**Impact:** ALL data access code must be rewritten  
**Effort:** 40-60 hours

**Issues:**
- `src/eShopLegacyWebForms/Models/CatalogDBContext.cs:8` - EF6 DbContext with DbModelBuilder

**Migration Path:**
```csharp
// OLD (EF6)
public class CatalogDBContext : DbContext
{
    public CatalogDBContext() : base("name=CatalogDBContext") { }
    
    protected override void OnModelCreating(DbModelBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.Entity<CatalogType>().HasKey(ci => ci.Id);
        builder.HasRequired<CatalogBrand>(ci => ci.CatalogBrand)
               .WithMany()
               .HasForeignKey(ci => ci.CatalogBrandId);
    }
}

// NEW (EF Core 8)
public class CatalogDbContext : DbContext
{
    public CatalogDbContext(DbContextOptions<CatalogDbContext> options)
        : base(options) { }
    
    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new CatalogTypeConfiguration());
        modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new CatalogItemConfiguration());
    }
}

// Separate configuration class
public class CatalogItemConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<CatalogItem>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<CatalogItem> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Catalog");
        builder.HasKey(ci => ci.Id);
        
        builder.HasOne(ci => ci.CatalogBrand)
               .WithMany()
               .HasForeignKey(ci => ci.CatalogBrandId)
               .IsRequired();
    }
}
```

// Application/Services/CatalogService.cs
public async Task<PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItemDto>> GetCatalogItemsPaginatedAsync(
    int pageSize, 
    int pageIndex, 
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
{
    var totalItems = await _catalogRepository.CountAsync(cancellationToken);
    
    var items = await _catalogRepository.GetPaginatedAsync(
        pageSize, 
        pageIndex, 
        cancellationToken);
    
    var itemDtos = _mapper.Map<IEnumerable<CatalogItemDto>>(items);
    
    return new PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItemDto>(
        pageIndex, pageSize, totalItems, itemDtos);
}

public async Task<int> CreateCatalogItemAsync(
    CatalogItemCreateDto createDto, 
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
{
    try
    {
        var catalogItem = _mapper.Map<CatalogItem>(createDto);
        catalogItem.Id = await _indexGenerator.GetNextSequenceValueAsync(cancellationToken);
        
        await _catalogRepository.AddAsync(catalogItem, cancellationToken);
        await _catalogRepository.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Created catalog item {ItemId}: {ItemName}", 
            catalogItem.Id, catalogItem.Name);
        
        return catalogItem.Id;
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Error creating catalog item: {Name}", createDto.Name);
        throw;
    }
}

## Migration Patterns & Best Practices

### Pattern 1: CRUD Page Migration

**Web Forms Pattern:**
```
Create.aspx (markup)
├── Server controls (TextBox, DropDownList, Button)
├── Validation controls (RequiredFieldValidator, RangeValidator)
└── Create.aspx.cs (code-behind)
    ├── Property injection for services
    ├── Page_Load event
    ├── Data binding methods (GetBrands(), GetTypes())
    └── Button click event handler
```

**Razor Pages Pattern:**
```
Create.cshtml (Razor view)
├── @page directive
├── @model directive
├── HTML form with Tag Helpers
│   ├── <input asp-for="Property" />
│   ├── <select asp-for asp-items>
│   └── <span asp-validation-for="Property">
└── Create.cshtml.cs (PageModel)
    ├── Constructor injection
    ├── [BindProperty] for form data
    ├── OnGetAsync() for GET requests
    └── OnPostAsync() for form submissions
```

### Pattern 2: Data Access

**Web Forms Pattern:**
```
Service directly uses DbContext
├── Synchronous operations
├── No repository abstraction
├── Entity Framework 6
└── Manual disposal
```

**Clean Architecture Pattern:**
```
PageModel → Service (Application Layer) → Repository (Infrastructure)
├── Async/await throughout
├── Repository interfaces in Domain
├── Entity Framework Core
├── DI-managed lifetimes (no manual disposal)
└── DTOs for data transfer
```

### Pattern 3: Configuration

**Web Forms:**
```
Web.config
├── <connectionStrings>
├── <appSettings>
├── <system.web>
└── ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Key"]
```

**.NET 8:**
```
appsettings.json
├── "ConnectionStrings": {}
├── "AppSettings": {}
├── "Logging": {}
└── IConfiguration["Section:Key"] or IOptions<T>
```

### Pattern 4: Dependency Injection

**Web Forms:**
```
Global.asax → Autofac container setup
├── IContainerProviderAccessor
├── ContainerProvider
├── Property injection via HTTP module
└── Manual container management
```

**.NET 8:**
```
Program.cs → builder.Services
├── AddScoped/AddTransient/AddSingleton
├── Constructor injection
├── Automatic lifetime management
└── Service location via HttpContext.RequestServices
```
